research.title: Four new languages arrive in SonarQube Cloud: MuleSoft DataWeave, Gosu, Groovy, and PowerShell
research.summary: Some of the most critical code in your stack has either run without independent verification for years or you’re using separate tooling than SonarQube to analyze that code. Integration flows move data between your systems. Gosu drives policy and claims.

research.title: Frontier AI Changes Vulnerability Discovery. It Doesn’t Change How Breaches Happen.
research.summary: Frontier AI is changing the economics of vulnerability discovery. Models are increasingly capable of finding, chaining, and exploiting vulnerabilities at machine speed, compressing timelines that once gave defenders more time to understand and remediate.
